summary: Iteration 22 preview backend verification. Confirmed all four required env vars present in /app/backend/.env (GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64, SIGNUP_SHEET_ID, LSCEO_GRANT_SHEET_ID, AIRTABLE_ACCESS_TOKEN). E2E test hit both share-a-service-account endpoints on preview URL and both returned HTTP 200 {ok:true, row_id:...}. This confirms the code path (including the _write_signup_to_google_sheet helper that raises 'Google service account not configured' when the env var is missing) is production-ready. The user's production error is therefore a deploy-platform env var configuration gap, not a code bug.

minor.issue: First attempt returned {ok:false, error:'Could not write the application to Google Sheets.'} due to a transient Google Sheets APIError 503 (service unavailable). Retry 5s later succeeded with row-17. Endpoint correctly surfaces the transient error without crashing but does not auto-retry Google 5xx responses. Consider adding a small retry-with-backoff around the gspread append_row call.

action_items: USER ACTION (production only): Configure GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64, SIGNUP_SHEET_ID, LSCEO_GRANT_SHEET_ID (and AIRTABLE_ACCESS_TOKEN) on the production deploy platform. Preview code path is verified working; no code changes needed.
Optional enhancement: add 1-2 retry attempts with backoff in _write_signup_to_google_sheet on gspread APIError 5xx to smooth over transient Google 503s.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L329-331 correctly surfaces missing GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64 as HTTPException(500) — this is the exact message the user reported on production, so the diagnostic is accurate.
Both /api/nominate-decline/submit and /api/lsceo-grant/submit share _write_signup_to_google_sheet; single point-of-fix on production env vars will resolve both endpoints simultaneously.
No retry logic around gspread append_row — a transient Google 503 during testing returned ok:false to the caller. Not blocking, but worth a small retry loop.

rca_of_the_issue: User's production error 'HTTPException: 500: Google service account not configured' is raised by server.py L329-331 when os.environ.get('GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64') is empty/missing. Preview has the var set and the same code path returned {ok:true} on both endpoints, proving the code is correct. Mitigation: set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_B64, SIGNUP_SHEET_ID, LSCEO_GRANT_SHEET_ID on the production deployment platform's env config and redeploy.
